author: JDVance
text:
I am proud to announce alongside many of our task force members that we are going to suspend 870,000 people who defrauded the government from ever being able to apply for these loans again.

It’s simple, if you screwed the American taxpayer, the federal government is going to cut you off from applying for benefits and if you try — you will be DENIED!
